mapper.insert: INSERT INTO loan_application (user_id, product_id, amount, term_months, annual_rate, purpose, status, apply_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{amount}, #{termMonths}, #{annualRate}, #{purpose}, #{status}, #{applyTime}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE loan_application SET status = #{status}, audit_time = #{auditTime}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan_application WHERE apply_time >= CURDATE() AND apply_time < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan_application WHERE status = 0

SELECT a.*, u.username, p.real_name as realName, pr.name as productName FROM loan_application a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_profile p ON a.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN loan_product pr ON a.product_id = pr.id WHERE a.status = 0 ORDER BY a.create_time DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM loan_application WHERE status = 1
